meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用测试先行方式开发新功能并修复缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是开发时习惯先写测试、再让代码通过的工程师
copy.tagline_en: Build features and fix bugs test-first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice red-green-refactor and want tests to drive your code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用“先写会失败的测试，再写刚好够用的代码让它通过”的方式一步步做，写前先和你确认测试边界，避免测试内部细节。
howto.when: 当你想以测试优先的方式加功能或修 bug，或提到“red-green-refactor”，或想要集成测试时，Claude 会进入 TDD 模式。

say.text: 用 TDD 帮我写一个用户注册功能，先写测试。
say.note: Claude 会先写失败测试并和你确认测试边界。

say.text: 我要修这个 bug，按 red-green-refactor 来。
say.note: Claude 按红-绿-重构流程处理。

say.text: 我们做集成测试，用测试优先的方式。
say.note: Claude 会进入 TDD 循环。

howto.what_en: Claude follows a red-green loop: write a failing test, then the minimal code to pass it. It also confirms test seams with you and avoids testing internal details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions 'red-green-refactor', or requests integration tests.

say_en.text: Use TDD to write a user registration feature. Write tests first.
say_en.note: Claude writes a failing test and confirms seams with you.

say_en.text: I want to fix this bug, follow red-green-refactor.
Let's write integration tests using test-first.
